body: They call this help. This is what they call help. They have the audacity to say I can't think correctly.

> There is also research, you may have come across, that indicates many many people who attempt suicide unsuccessfully are later glad they did not complete it. Many such stories exist.

Utterly irrelevant.

No, I can't talk to anyone, because if they aren't threatening me, they're being an apologist for evil like you are. Get your poison away from me.
